gives it.

oneOf.description: The plain output: fully resolved CommonMark with no HTML.

integration receives it.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

emit.description:
Which output `text` is written as: `plain`, the build's plain
output, or `site`, its site output.

not_published.description:
Why the build doesn't publish the page, when it doesn't; `text` is
empty then.

page.description: The page, as a path from the content root.

route.description: The page's route in the build's site.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

text.description:
The page as the output `emit` names writes it: with its frontmatter
first when asked for.
